observations.body: Scattered believers preach, Philip’s signs bring joy in Samaria, people are baptized, and Peter and John come from Jerusalem, pray, and lay hands so they receive the Holy Spirit.
observations.label: Samaritans receive the Holy Spirit after receiving the word

observations.body: The passage presents Word and baptism before Spirit reception as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Word and baptism before Spirit reception

observations.body: The passage places Philip, Peter, and John beside Word and baptism before Spirit reception.
observations.label: Philip, Peter, and John

payload.posture: Read Acts 8:4–17 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states scattered believers preach, Philip’s signs bring joy in Samaria, people are baptized, and Peter and John come from Jerusalem, pray, and lay hands so they receive the Holy Spirit. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Samaritans receive the Holy Spirit after receiving the word
